description: the weights on the simplex that minimise the pool's own CRPS on a validation period held back from inside the training frame; computed exactly from the sample-based CRPS identity

premise.objective: mean over validation cells of sum_m w_m A_m - 0.5 w' B w

what_the_premise_implies: the minimum-CRPS pool is a corner-seeking solution: it is predicted to put at least one member at a weight below 0.05, which the sibling cannot do at all. It is predicted to place more weight on the two candidate families than on the two required baselines. And because the weights are fitted on the last few blocks of the training frame while the score is taken on the blocks after it, the fitted weights are predicted to be a worse guide to the evaluated period than to the validation period -- so the pool is predicted to beat the equal pool by less than the difference between them on the validation period
